[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Salvage and land the verified -p display-name resolution fix [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#AF87FF]salvage-display-name[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]project token as a directory key only, so `sase repo list -p sase` exits[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]2 on master (+10 corroboration). The complete, verified fix — [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]registry-canonicalized -p accepting key, display name, or alias, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regression tests — sits uncommitted in the sase_21 workspace clone on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]athena (base 99932634cd). Salvage that diff, rebase it onto current [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]master, re-run its tests, and land it before workspace retention [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reclaims the state.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop runner module imports from replacing the process SIGTERM [bold black on #87D7FF][/bold #D7AFFF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]handler (sase-1s2)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]sigterm-import[dim] · [dim][/dim]after salvage-display-name[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]sase.axe.mentor_runner (line 30) installs a soft SIGTERM handler at [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]import time, replacing the caller's handler in every importer (pytest [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workers, tool runs). Move the install into the runner-owned entry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lifecycle, keeping production shutdown semantics, and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fresh-interpreter import plus real-entry signal tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop done monitors with stale followup_pending from owning [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]beads forever (sase-1re)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-ownership[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sigterm-import[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-ownership: a monitor member that is done but still reports [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]followup_pending=true (stale next_action, no followup_outcome) reduces [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to owned/monitor in sase-core stranded_work/classify.rs owner_kind() [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]forever, hiding the bead from STRANDED and the recovery reconciler. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Root-cause why the follow-up never settled, then bound ownership using [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]actual delivery/recovery facts, distinguishing a dead abandoned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-up from a queued successor, a live monitor, and settlement grace.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Needs a sase-core change and pin move.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop continuation capture from nesting fork ancestry past the [bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]256 KiB cap (sase-1o1)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]continuation-capture[dim] · [dim][/dim]after monitor-ownership[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]continuation-capture: persist_agent_delta records the #fork-expanded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]step prompt as authored_local_request and replay renders it as the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parent user block, so every session member re-nests its whole ancestry; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a live athena land session is at 708,391 bytes against the 262,144-byte [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]validator cap, and an over-cap turn fails capture and settles the next [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor follow-up not-launchable. Capture only the local pre-fork [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]request, make replay walk the parent chain, keep fork-replay output [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]byte-stable, and add a repair or explicit error for in-flight over-cap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sessions. Needs sase-core and sase changes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop host completion from refusing checks that passed [/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF](sase-1qm)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]fingerprint-refusal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after continuation-capture[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fingerprint-refusal: prepared completions backed by a fully green just [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]check are refused with stale_worktree_fingerprint even when every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]observed fingerprint matches on hand audit (5 refusals in October, 11 so[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]far in November; fresh sase recurrences 11-07 and 11-10). Diff the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sealed observation against the host-time observation for the fresh repro[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runs (suspect: cross-repo scope over main plus sase-core), fix the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]confirmed mechanism, and make every refusal record name which [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fingerprint component differed. Needs sase-core and sase changes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make sase agent restart find crash-killed agents (sase-1qi, [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]ride-along sase-1qr)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]agent-identity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fingerprint-refusal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]agent-identity: a kill or reboot that never writes done.json leaves the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TUI showing FAILED while sase agent restart returns not-found, because [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]find_named_agent skips non-done records with dead PIDs (correct for wait[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolution, wrong for restart). Give restart a lookup that includes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dead-without-done records without deleting the liveness skip waiters [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rely on. Ride-along per decision qr_ride_along: project process_identity[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the sase-core agent scan so the PID-reuse guard stops degrading [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to PID-only for scanned records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify an existing attachments-private remote is actually [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]private before pushing (sase-1db)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]private-remote-verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after agent-identity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]private-remote-verify: preflight_sidecars compares visibility only when [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]creating a missing attachments-private remote; an existing remote is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trusted on its configured role alone and describe_label hard-codes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]"(private)", so attachment bytes can be pushed to a public repository [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under a private label. Probe visibility for existing remotes with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolve_remote_visibility at repo-init preflight and at the shared write[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]boundary before the first upload per process, define honest [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unknown-visibility handling, and stop hard-coding the label.[/#D7D7AF]
